en.title: Six straight losses and no Hellebuyck: the Jets visit an unbeaten home team
en.deck: Winnipeg has lost six in a row (0-4-2) and scored just 10 goals in that run, days after trading Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey. Tampa Bay is 5-0-0 at home but may be without Brandon Hagel and Victor Hedman. The market is more confident in the Lightning than the model is.
news: The Jets sent Hellebuyck to the Devils on Oct. 23 after he asked for a trade and skipped camp. Dawson Mercer and Nick Bjugstad (out after pectoral surgery) came back in the deal.

Coach Scott Arniel says the net is decided day to day. Stuart Skinner (.911) is the expected starter, but Clay Stevenson started the 5-1 loss to Florida on Tuesday. Nothing was confirmed on Thursday morning.

Tampa Bay: Hagel, tied for the team lead in goals, missed practice Tuesday and Wednesday and is a game-time decision. Zemgus Girgensons is out and Hedman is day-to-day. Andrei Vasilevskiy is the likely starter.
Winnipeg also plays Florida on Friday, so this is the first half of a back-to-back.
records: Winnipeg has scored more than three goals only once all season.
The Jets' power play is 0-for-14 over their last five games.
Tampa Bay has lost two straight on the road but is still perfect at home this season.
Hedman has 815 career points in 1,174 games. Kucherov leads the Lightning with 14 points.
betting: Market: Lightning 1.43, Jets 2.90, about 67–33 without the margin. The model has Tampa Bay at 60%. It sees the Jets' finishing as unlucky, while the market prices the skid and the Hagel and Hedman news is still open.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.73 (about 55%). The model says 54%, so they agree. The last six meetings averaged 6.2 goals.
Player chances (model): Kucherov 1+ point 78%, Hagel goal 40% if he plays, Kyle Connor goal 36% (the 2.85 price implies about 35%).

sv.title: Sex raka förluster och ingen Hellebuyck: Jets möter ett obesegrat hemmalag
sv.deck: Winnipeg har förlorat sex raka (0-4-2) och bara gjort 10 mål under sviten, dagar efter att Connor Hellebuyck tradades till New Jersey. Tampa Bay är 5-0-0 hemma men kan sakna Brandon Hagel och Victor Hedman. Marknaden tror mer på Lightning än modellen gör.
news: Jets skickade Hellebuyck till Devils den 23 oktober efter att han begärt trade och skippat lägret. I affären kom bland andra Dawson Mercer och Nick Bjugstad (borta efter en bröstmuskeloperation).

Tränaren Scott Arniel säger att målvaktsvalet görs dag för dag. Stuart Skinner (,911) väntas starta, men Clay Stevenson stod i 1–5-förlusten mot Florida i tisdags. Inget var bekräftat på torsdagsmorgonen.

Tampa Bay: Hagel, delad skytteligaledare i laget, missade träningarna i tisdags och onsdags och avgörs först före matchen. Zemgus Girgensons är borta och Hedman är osäker. Andrei Vasilevskiy väntas starta.
Winnipeg spelar mot Florida redan på fredag, så det här är första matchen av två på två dagar.
records: Winnipeg har gjort fler än tre mål bara en gång den här säsongen.
Jets powerplay har gått 0 av 14 de senaste fem matcherna.
Tampa Bay har förlorat två raka på bortaplan men har inte tappat poäng hemma än.
Hedman har 815 poäng på 1 174 matcher i karriären. Kucherov leder Lightning med 14 poäng.

en.title: Malkin returns as Utah opens a six-game road trip in Pittsburgh
en.deck: Pittsburgh has won two straight for the first time since its 2-0 start, and Evgeni Malkin, Egor Chinakhov and Ben Kindel are set to return. Utah lost a heated 3-1 game to Minnesota on Tuesday and starts a six-game trip. Both teams' games tend to run high, and the market agrees.
news: Malkin is over his illness, Chinakhov is back from a lower-body injury, and Kindel returns after a medical episode on the team plane. Sam Girard is also expected back. Bryan Rust is out at least six weeks.
Elmer Soderblom is day-to-day with an upper-body injury and did not practise Wednesday.

Utah's loss to Minnesota had three fights and 52 penalty minutes. Clayton Keller took an abuse-of-officials penalty just before the winning goal. Coach André Tourigny backed him but wants him calmer, and Keller said he has to lay off the referees.
Utah: John Marino is week-to-week. Karel Vejmelka made 27 saves on Tuesday and is projected again, unconfirmed. Arturs Silovs is the likely Penguins starter.
records: Utah won the first meeting 5-4 on Oct. 19. The last seven meetings averaged 7.1 goals.
77% of Utah's games have gone over 5.5 goals, one of the highest rates in the league.
Utah's power play has scored on more than a third of its chances (16-for-46).
Malkin has six goals in 11 games, and the model flags his finishing as running hot.
betting: Market: Mammoth 1.76, Penguins 2.12, about 55–45 for Utah without the margin. The model has it 52–48, a little warmer on Pittsburgh.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.48 (about 64%). The model says 62% and expects 6.6 goals, so both lean high. Over 6.5: market about 54%, model 52%.

sv.title: Malkin tillbaka när Utah inleder sex raka bortamatcher i Pittsburgh
sv.deck: Pittsburgh har vunnit två raka för första gången sedan 2-0-starten, och Evgeni Malkin, Egor Chinakhov och Ben Kindel väntas göra comeback. Utah förlorade en het match mot Minnesota med 1–3 i tisdags och inleder nu en bortaresa på sex matcher. Båda lagens matcher brukar bli målrika, och marknaden håller med.
news: Malkin är frisk efter sin sjukdom, Chinakhov är tillbaka från en skada i underkroppen och Kindel återvänder efter en medicinsk incident på lagets flyg. Även Sam Girard väntas tillbaka. Bryan Rust är borta i minst sex veckor.
Elmer Soderblom är osäker med en överkroppsskada och tränade inte i onsdags.

Utahs förlust mot Minnesota innehöll tre slagsmål och 52 utvisningsminuter. Clayton Keller fick en utvisning för att ha skällt på domarna strax före det avgörande målet. Tränaren André Tourigny försvarade honom men vill se mer lugn, och Keller sa själv att han måste låta domarna vara.
Utah: John Marino är borta på veckobasis. Karel Vejmelka gjorde 27 räddningar i tisdags och väntas starta igen, obekräftat. Arturs Silovs väntas stå för Penguins.
records: Utah vann säsongens första möte med 5–4 den 19 oktober. De sju senaste mötena hade i snitt 7,1 mål.
77 % av Utahs matcher har gått över 5,5 mål, bland de högsta andelarna i ligan.
Utahs powerplay har gjort mål på mer än var tredje chans (16 av 46).
Malkin har sex mål på 11 matcher, och modellen flaggar att hans avslut går varmt.

en.title: The NHL's best team meets a Columbus side living in overtime
en.deck: Carolina is 10-2-2, the best record in the league, with Pyotr Kochetkov unbeaten at 8-0-0. Columbus has won two straight for the first time this season, both in overtime. The model gives Columbus a bit less than the price does, and it leans to goals.
news: Sebastian Aho scored the winner against Boston on Tuesday, his 69th career game-winning goal, extending his own franchise record.
Kochetkov has started the last two games, so Brandon Bussi (2-2-2) could get the net. No starter was confirmed Thursday morning.
Taylor Hall was activated from injured reserve on Monday but got hurt again at the morning skate on Tuesday. Rod Brind'Amour said he will be out for a little bit. Mark Jankowski is back.
Columbus blew a 3-0 lead in Philadelphia and won 4-3 in overtime on Kent Johnson's second goal. Dante Fabbro made his season debut. Jet Greaves and Cam Talbot are both options in goal.
records: Kochetkov's 8-0-0 start ties a Hurricanes franchise record, with a 1.62 goals-against average.
Carolina has a four-game point streak, and Nikolaj Ehlers and Jackson Blake have four-game point streaks of their own.
Columbus has only one regulation win this season, the opener against Buffalo.
Zach Werenski has eight assists but no goals in 10 games. The model expects his goals to come.
betting: Market: Hurricanes 1.43, Blue Jackets 2.95, about 67–33 without the margin. The model has Carolina at 64%, slightly kinder to Columbus. Nearly all public tickets are on Carolina.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.68 (about 56%). The model says 59% and expects 6.4 goals, a lean to the over. The last 12 meetings averaged 6.6 goals.

en.title: Kane returns to Detroit one assist short of 900
en.deck: Patrick Kane is back in Detroit, where he spent the last three seasons, needing one assist for 900. Chicago is still looking for its first road win (0-4), while Detroit has points in seven of its last eight. The model and the market see this game almost exactly the same way.
news: Chicago beat Los Angeles 2-1 on Tuesday on Wyatt Kaiser's third-period goal. Kane started the play for his 899th career assist.
Coach Jeff Blashill, a former Red Wings head coach, said his team simply needs wins. Spencer Knight is the projected starter.
Detroit won 4-3 in a shootout in Edmonton on Monday behind Michal Postava, 24, in his first NHL start. Daniil Tarasov is back on the ice, and John Gibson is projected to start.
Marco Kasper and Mason Appleton are at least two weeks away. J.T. Compher is back. Dylan Larkin has not withdrawn his offseason trade request.
records: Roman Kantserov leads all NHL rookies with five goals.
Detroit is 4-1-1 in its last six after a rough start that had fans booing at Little Caesars Arena.
Moritz Seider has six assists but no goals in 12 games.

en.title: Pastrnak chases Bergeron as the Blues try to end a 124-minute drought
en.deck: St. Louis has been shut out in back-to-back home games and has not scored in 123:55. Boston is 9-3-1, and captain David Pastrnak is one goal from passing Patrice Bergeron for third in Bruins history. Model and market both see a coin flip, but the model expects fewer goals.
news: Boston lost 2-1 in Carolina on Tuesday, ending an eight-game point streak (7-0-1). Marco Sturm said he did not mind the game. Matt Poitras and Charlie McAvoy both left briefly and returned.
The Blues lost 4-0 to Carolina and 2-0 to Montreal, where Jacob Fowler made 46 saves. Jim Montgomery wants his team to shoot from closer to the net.
Jordan Binnington started Tuesday. Joel Hofer and Jeremy Swayman are the expected starters, both unconfirmed.
Thursday ends a five-game St. Louis homestand and a two-game Boston road trip.
records: Pastrnak's 427 goals tie Bergeron for third in Bruins history, behind Johnny Bucyk and Phil Esposito.
It is the first time since October 2009 that the Blues have been shut out in consecutive home games.
Robert Thomas is tied with Brian Sutter at 333 assists. One more puts him fourth alone on the Blues' all-time list.
Boston swept last season's series with two 5-2 wins. The Bruins' shooting plus save percentage (PDO 1.070) is among the league's highest, which usually cools off.
betting: Market: Blues 1.86, Bruins 1.98, about 52–48 without the margin. The model says 51–49, so they agree. Most of the public money is on Boston.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.76 (about 54%). The model says 51%, a slight lean to the under given the Blues' drought and two goalies stopping over 91%.

Blues förlorade med 0–4 mot Carolina och 0–2 mot Montreal, där Jacob Fowler gjorde 46 räddningar. Jim Montgomery vill att laget skjuter närmare mål.
Jordan Binnington startade i tisdags. Joel Hofer och Jeremy Swayman väntas starta, båda obekräftade.
Torsdagen avslutar fem raka hemmamatcher för St. Louis och en bortaresa på två matcher för Boston.

en.title: Ovechkin's last regular-season stop in Nashville, on Trotz's night
en.deck: Alex Ovechkin, who has said this is his final season, plays his last regular-season game in Nashville as the Predators induct Barry Trotz into their Golden Hall. Washington won 5-2 on Wednesday and is on the second night of a back-to-back. The market has an even game; the model leans Nashville.
news: Trotz coached Nashville from 1998 to 2014 and won the 2018 Stanley Cup with Ovechkin in Washington. He is honoured in a pregame ceremony.

Washington beat Philadelphia 5-2 on Wednesday. Alex Tuch and Jordan Kyrou scored twice each, Dylan Strome had three assists, and Logan Thompson returned from injury. Charlie Lindgren is the likely starter on the back half.
Nashville lost 4-3 in a shootout to the Islanders after rallying from 0-3. Ryan O'Reilly scored the tying goal and Juuse Saros made 25 saves.
Capitals out: Vincent Desharnais, Rasmus Sandin and Patrick Thomas.
records: Tuch has nine goals in his first 11 games, the most by a Capital since Ovechkin had 10 in 11 in 2021-22.
Ovechkin has 930 career goals but one this season. He has 20 goals in 31 career games against Nashville.
Nashville is 0-0-5 in games that go past regulation.
Filip Forsberg's 98th career power-play goal moved him past Kent Nilsson for 11th among Swedish-born players.

en.title: Kaprizov's historic October meets a depleted Islanders lineup
en.deck: Kirill Kaprizov leads the NHL with 14 goals in 14 games, and Minnesota is first in the West at 9-3-2. The Islanders are without Mathew Barzal and two more forwards but won in Nashville on Tuesday. The model gives New York more of a chance than the market does.
news: Minnesota won its last three road games by a combined 12-4, including 3-1 in Utah on Tuesday. John Hynes called Kaprizov's start no fluke.
Jared Spurgeon is uncertain after blocking two shots on the penalty kill in Utah. Jesper Wallstedt (8-2-2, .922) is the likely starter.
The Islanders won 4-3 in a shootout in Nashville behind Semyon Varlamov, so Ilya Sorokin (.919) is expected back in net. New coach Pete DeBoer called it a big two points.
Barzal (knee) did not travel. Matias Maccelli (two to four weeks) and Calum Ritchie (four to six weeks) went on injured reserve on Monday.
records: Kaprizov is the eighth player in NHL history with 14 or more goals in October. Only Mario Lemieux and Brett Hull scored more in a single October.
Kaprizov has 498 career points, two from 500.
Brayden Schenn has 300 career goals.
Both teams have gone over 5.5 goals in fewer than half their games.
betting: Market: Wild 1.53, Islanders 2.60, about 63–37 without the margin. The model has 57–43, warmer on the Islanders, mostly because of Sorokin.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.79 (about 53%), and the model also says 53%. They agree.
Player chances (model): Kaprizov goal 49% (the 1.89 price implies about 53%), Quinn Hughes 1+ point 67%, Horvat goal 31%.

en.title: Ducks look to recover from a blown 5-2 lead as Buffalo rides a shutout
en.deck: Anaheim gave up three late goals and lost 6-5 in overtime to Vancouver, its sixth loss in seven games. Buffalo won 2-0 in San Jose behind Colten Ellis and is favoured in Anaheim. The model is closer to even than the market and agrees on lots of goals.
news: Ellis made 23 saves for his second NHL shutout in his first game in more than two weeks. He is projected to start again over Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen (.866), unconfirmed.
Joel Quenneville called the loss to Vancouver terrible and blamed careless plays. Captain Mikael Granlund said blowing that lead was unacceptable.
Anaheim is without Troy Terry, Ryan Poehling, Ian Moore and Pavel Mintyukov. Lukas Dostal is the projected starter.
Tage Thompson had an assist in his 500th game with Buffalo. Jiri Kulich is out with a concussion.
records: Beckett Sennecke has scored in four straight home games. His 30 career goals in 94 games are the fourth-fastest pace in Ducks history.
Leo Carlsson has 15 points in 12 games. His 65 goals are the second-most by a Swede before turning 22, behind Mats Sundin.
Anaheim started 4-1 but is 1-3-1 at home. 75% of its games have gone over 5.5 goals.
The last six meetings averaged 7.0 goals.
betting: Market: Sabres 1.78, Ducks 2.08, about 54–46 for Buffalo without the margin. The model has Anaheim at 52%, one of the bigger gaps of the night. Its edge comes from the Ducks' scoring; Anaheim's expected-goal share (44%) argues the other way.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.56 (about 61%), and the model says the same. Over 6.5 is close to 50% for both.
Player chances (model): Sennecke goal 35% (flagged as finishing hot), Carlsson 1+ point 60%, Thompson goal 40%.

sv.deck: Anaheim släppte in tre sena mål och förlorade med 5–6 efter förlängning mot Vancouver, lagets sjätte förlust på sju matcher. Buffalo vann med 2–0 i San Jose med Colten Ellis i mål och är favorit i Anaheim. Modellen ser matchen jämnare än marknaden och håller med om att det blir många mål.
news: Ellis gjorde 23 räddningar och tog sin andra nolla i NHL i sin första match på över två veckor. Han väntas starta igen före Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen (,866), obekräftat.
Joel Quenneville kallade förlusten mot Vancouver fruktansvärd och skyllde på slarv. Kaptenen Mikael Granlund sa att det var oacceptabelt att tappa den ledningen.
Anaheim saknar Troy Terry, Ryan Poehling, Ian Moore och Pavel Mintyukov. Lukas Dostal väntas starta.
Tage Thompson hade en assist i sin 500:e match för Buffalo. Jiri Kulich är borta med en hjärnskakning.
records: Beckett Sennecke har gjort mål i fyra raka hemmamatcher. Hans 30 mål på 94 matcher är det fjärde snabbaste i Ducks historia.
Leo Carlsson har 15 poäng på 12 matcher. Hans 65 mål är näst flest av en svensk före 22 års ålder, efter Mats Sundin.
Anaheim startade med 4-1 men är 1-3-1 hemma. 75 % av lagets matcher har gått över 5,5 mål.
De sex senaste mötena hade i snitt 7,0 mål.

Totalt: marknaden har över 5,5 på 1,56 (cirka 61 %), och modellen säger samma sak. Över 6,5 ligger nära 50 % för båda.

en.title: Kings open a seven-game homestand still looking for a home win
en.deck: Los Angeles is 0-3-0 at home and second-to-last in the Pacific, and Drew Doughty and Corey Perry are day-to-day. Ottawa lost its trip opener in Vegas and is still without Linus Ullmark. The market sees a pure coin flip, and the model nearly does too.
news: Ottawa lost 4-1 in Vegas on Tuesday, two of the goals into an empty net. Travis Green said it was essentially a 2-1 game and called the effort pretty good.
Warren Foegele is day-to-day after a hit by Jeremy Lauzon. Thomas Chabot is out, and Ullmark (7-1-0, .945) is on injured reserve. Jonas Johansson is projected to start.

The Kings lost 2-1 in Chicago, the second half of a back-to-back. Peter Laviolette said they have been tied 1-1 in the third too many times. Doughty and Perry were late scratches with bumps and bruises.
Los Angeles is also without Kevin Fiala and Mats Zuccarello. Anton Forsberg is projected in goal, unconfirmed.
records: The Kings lost six straight before going 3-2-0 on their road trip.
Drake Batherson has an eight-point, five-game point streak. Tim Stützle leads Ottawa with 16 points.
Without Ullmark, Samuel Ersson is 0-3-0 with an .835 save percentage.
Neither team goes over 5.5 often: 38% of Ottawa's games and 36% of Los Angeles' games.
betting: Market: Kings 1.92, Senators 1.92, 50–50 without the margin. The model has Los Angeles at 53%, a small lean.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.78 (about 53%), and the model also says 53%. They agree, though both teams' low over rates point the other way.
Player chances (model): Panarin goal 39% (the 2.70 price implies about 37%), Stützle 1+ point 62%, Batherson 1+ point 53%.

en.title: Canucks bring their streak-breaking comeback to San Jose
en.deck: Vancouver ended a 10-game losing streak with a 6-5 overtime win in Anaheim after trailing 5-2 late. San Jose has lost two straight and was outshot 40-23 by Buffalo. The market makes the Sharks clear favourites; the model is warmer on Vancouver.
news: Jonathan Lekkerimaki scored twice with the goalie pulled, and Filip Hronek won it on a 5-on-3 with 11 seconds left in overtime. Coach Manny Malhotra said the streak had weighed on the room.
Thatcher Demko is out (hip). Leevi Meriläinen is projected to start again, unconfirmed.
Ryan Warsofsky reshuffled every line and pairing before the Buffalo game and split up Macklin Celebrini and Will Smith. Alexander Wennberg is out.
Yaroslav Askarov has made 38 or more saves in two straight games and is projected to start.
records: Vancouver is 3-10-1 and allows 4.6 goals a game, and its share of expected goals (38%) is the lowest of any team on Thursday's slate.
Elias Pettersson has 26 points in 26 career games against San Jose, and Brock Boeser has 13 goals in 30.
Lekkerimaki has seven points in his last five games. Boeser has goals in two straight.
Celebrini, who grew up in North Vancouver, has 15 points in 11 games.
betting: Market: Sharks 1.52, Canucks 2.60, about 63–37 without the margin. The model has 56–44, warmer on Vancouver, since it doesn't trust San Jose's weak shot share either.
Total: the market prices over 5.5 at 1.52 (about 63%). The model says 59%, a little lower, but it still expects 6.4 goals.
Player chances (model): Celebrini 1+ point 77% and goal 44% (the 1.97 price implies about 51%), Boeser goal 31%, Will Smith goal 32%.

sv.deck: Vancouver bröt en förlustsvit på tio matcher med en 6–5-seger efter förlängning i Anaheim efter att ha legat under med 2–5 sent. San Jose har förlorat två raka och sköts över med 23–40 av Buffalo. Marknaden gör Sharks till klara favoriter, modellen tror mer på Vancouver.
news: Jonathan Lekkerimaki gjorde två mål med tom bur och Filip Hronek avgjorde i fem mot tre med 11 sekunder kvar av förlängningen. Tränaren Manny Malhotra sa att sviten hade tyngt laget.
Thatcher Demko är borta (höft). Leevi Meriläinen väntas starta igen, obekräftat.
Ryan Warsofsky kastade om alla kedjor och backpar inför Buffalo-matchen och splittrade Macklin Celebrini och Will Smith. Alexander Wennberg är borta.
Yaroslav Askarov har gjort minst 38 räddningar i två raka matcher och väntas starta.
records: Vancouver är 3-10-1 och släpper in 4,6 mål per match, och lagets andel av de förväntade målen (38 %) är lägst av alla lag på torsdagens program.
Elias Pettersson har 26 poäng på 26 matcher mot San Jose, och Brock Boeser har 13 mål på 30.
Lekkerimaki har sju poäng de senaste fem matcherna. Boeser har gjort mål i två raka.
Celebrini, som växte upp i North Vancouver, har 15 poäng på 11 matcher.
betting: Marknaden: Sharks 1,52, Canucks 2,60, ungefär 63–37 utan marginal. Modellen säger 56–44, mer för Vancouver, eftersom den inte heller litar på San Joses svaga skottandel.
Totalt: marknaden har över 5,5 på 1,52 (cirka 63 %). Modellen säger 59 %, lite lägre, men väntar sig ändå 6,4 mål.
